alt: Real ChatGPT /checklist execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /checklist Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-item checklist for understanding training, inference and context. Include completion progress and reset. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.
